responseMessageContents.text:
The "Add Your Own Mountain" feature is now fully implemented. Here's what was added:

**New orange "+" button** in the peaks list header — tap it to open the Add Peak modal.

**Add Peak screen** lets you enter:
- Name & elevation (required)
- Country, mountain range, coordinates (optional)
- Difficulty selector
- Description

**Full integration** — custom peaks:
- Appear in the main peaks list (filterable via the "My Peaks" category chip)
- Show on the map with markers
- Count toward your dashboard stats, category progress, and completion percentage
- Can be summited just like built-in peaks
- Can be deleted from the mountain detail page (with confirmation)

All data persists locally via AsyncStorage.
